label: BASE_DIR
description:
The absolute filesystem path to the directory containing your Django project. This is typically the directory containing `manage.py`. It's used as the base for constructing other paths like `DATABASES.NAME` for SQLite, `STATICFILES_DIRS`, and template directories.

This setting is defined in the default project template created by `django-admin startproject`, but is not an official Django setting.
example:
from pathlib import Path

BASE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
name: BASE_DIR
